thread:
Eve: alert - repeated CUDA OOMs on gpu-node-17 for rdx-7b-quant, started ~10m ago. Headroom shows ~1.1GB but alloc fails. Seeing 503s for some dedicated requests.

Incident Bot: Created INC-2605 (P2). Runbook: gpu-oom-first-response. Paging oncall.

Ben: any deploys or config changes?

Eve: no deploys. Typical seq 1024, bursts to 4096. Prefetch enabled.

Carol: paste from allocator logs: 
```
E 12:22:18 allocator.cc:398 try_reserve failed size=134217728 contiguous_needed=1 reserved_by=3 free_headroom=1181023456
CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
```

Dave: headroom can't see pinned/fragmented holes. Could be many small reserved blocks fragmenting contiguous allocation.

Ben: get reserved-block table, kv-cache stats, prefetch queue length, sparepool.

Eve: kv-cache ~1.15M keys, prefetch-queue peaked 130, sparepool free=3 blocks. reserved blocks held by prefetcher-worker-3 and -4.

Carol: hypothesis: prefetcher grabs reserves for chunks and doesn't release on failed downstream allocation -> ghost pins. Allocator counts them but headroom calc treats them as free? mismatch.

Dave: mitigation plan: (1) disable aggressive prefetch on that node, (2) route new inferences to fallback nodes, (3) reduce max-reserve-per-worker. Thoughts?

Ben: +1. Also enforce smaller contiguous allocations for prefetched chunks temporarily. I'll coordinate changes.

Eve: executed: `systemctl stop redwood-prefetch@3` on gpu-node-17. Confirming reserved count dropping.

Ops Bot: Routing policy applied: node gpu-node-17 set to drain; new requests go to fallback pool.

Carol: applied runtime config override: max_reserve_per_worker=1 on gpu-node-17 (patch ia/2605/1). Watching stability.

Ben: OOM events dropped after drain + stop prefetch. Headroom metric still static but contiguous-blocks increased. Good.

Eve: customer impact: 5 dedicated customers saw transient 503s for ~6-8 minutes. Logged SUP-8142 and notifying affected accounts.

Dave: root cause (working theory): prefetch reservation logic races with allocator spill path; leads to many scattered pinned blocks so large contiguous reserve fails despite aggregate headroom. Need: smaller reserved chunk sizes or opportunistic release on failed allocations.

Carol: filed GH infra/allocator#1251 with logs, trace IDs, repro steps. Tagging runtime, prefetch, telemetry.

Ben: follow-ups: schedule frag-scan job (frag-scan/inc-2605), add per-worker pinned-reserve metric, and implement prefetch backoff when contiguous free blocks < threshold.

Eve: oncall handoff in 18m. Ben primary, Carol secondary. I'll update incident doc and transfer context.

Incident Bot: INC-2605 -> mitigated (monitoring). Time to mitigate: 12m. Please assign postmortem owner.

Ben: creating incident doc /incidents/2605 and assigning postmortem to Carol. Will publish timeline and customer impact summary later. :thumbsup:
